name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd
title: Viceroy Hotels Ltd - 523796 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hotel operator (Hyderabad Marriott/Courtyard, new Executive Apartments) with Q4 revenue +35% largely from acquisition; ADR softened in March, FY26 EBITDA margin 29.8%, and capex and debt are rising with no supply-discipline signal.

utilisation.quote: Q1-Q2, while it operates at 70% occupancy across the portfolio, at Q3-Q4, we can expect to be 80% and north of 80%.

capex.quote: We outlined a plan to invest 100 plus crores to renovate and upgrade existing properties in three phases.

triggers.label: Marriott Executive Apartments acquired, ~INR 215 cr
triggers.quote: for a total consideration of around INR 215 crores

triggers.label: Q4 ADR softened in March
triggers.quote: ADR performance during the quarter reflected the relatively softer operating environment witnessed across the hospitality sector during March.

triggers.label: Madhapur Courtyard targeted FY29-FY30
triggers.quote: we would say we are targeting the opening date to be FY '29 or FY '30.

guidance.quote: on year-on-year growth, we will have a double-digit growth as we have explained in our previous call as well.

guidance.value: Rs 9,000 to 9,500 in immediate term; ~Rs 10,000 long run
guidance.quote: the current levels of 7,000 odd is something that we aim to target reaching 9,000 to 9,500 in a more immediate basis.
We are going to see a substantial twofold increase in the EBITDAs because of this addition.
we expect to give you a good outcome from next year.

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT down ~40% YoY
red_flags.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR 6 crores, which was impacted during the quarter primarily due to the higher depreciation and finance costs

red_flags.label: Debt rose sharply to fund acquisition
red_flags.quote: the debt was at zero. And so based on this, that's why the interest cost has also gone up.

red_flags.label: Courtyard occupancy fell to 52.2% in FY26
red_flags.quote: The courtyard occupancy dropped significantly from 72.6% to 52.2% in FY '26.

red_flags.label: Management pursuing NCLT distressed assets
red_flags.quote: Yes, we have shown an expression of interest to a lot of these assets, but nothing has materialized as of yet.

evasions.quote: obviously, projections of the numbers is something while I can't share with you.
as of 31st March 2026, our borrowings are at INR 264 crores(on a consolidated basis).
